description: This file defines a set of React components wrapping Radix UI's Dialog primitives to provide a styled, composable dialog/modal component set for a Next.js frontend project. It includes components for dialog structure (content, overlay, header, footer, title, description, trigger, close, portal) and manages styling through class names and utility functions.

methods.name: Dialog
methods.description: A wrapper component around Radix UI's Root component, representing the main dialog container.

methods.name: DialogClose
methods.description: A component that renders a close button for the dialog, wrapping Radix UI's Close component and adding styling.

methods.name: DialogContent
methods.description: A component that composes portal, overlay, and content structure for the dialog, applying styles and positioning.

methods.name: DialogDescription
methods.description: A component for the dialog's description text, styled appropriately.

methods.name: DialogFooter
methods.description: A styled container for dialog footer elements.

methods.name: DialogHeader
methods.description: A styled container for dialog header elements.

methods.name: DialogTitle
methods.description: A component for the dialog's title text, styled with larger font and font-weight.

methods.name: DialogTrigger
methods.description: A component that renders a trigger element to open the dialog.
